# proxmox_custom_cpu_model (Resource)

Manages a custom QEMU CPU model through `/cluster/qemu/custom-cpu-models`. Import by `cputype`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_custom_cpu_model" "m" {
  cputype        = "custom-x"
  reported_model = "qemu64"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cputype` (String) Model name, must start with `custom-`.
- `reported_model` (String)

### Optional

- `flags` (String)
- `guest_phys_bits` (Number)
- `hidden` (Boolean)
- `hv_vendor_id` (String)
- `level` (Number)
- `phys_bits` (String)

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
